data.name: Resist Interrogation
data.description: A code runner gains a +%1 bonus on saving throws against divination effects.|RangerLVL/2

raw_tokens.value: A code runner gains a +%1 bonus on saving throws against divination effects.|RangerLVL/2

If he succeeds at a saving throw against a divination effect that would grant its caster knowledge or information, the caster is not aware that the saving throw was successful, and the code runner can attempt a Bluff check opposed by the caster's Sense Motive check in order to send false information to the caster.|PRECLASS:1,Ranger=11
